source.quote: أعلنت إدارة نادي الرياض عن توقيع عقد رعاية جديد مع منصة “تأميني” الرائدة في مجال وساطة التأمين الطبي وتأمين السيارات
source.note: Club announcement that Tameeni is a sponsor (English: the club management announced a new sponsorship contract with the Tameeni platform, a leader in medical insurance brokerage and car insurance). summary: Black Panther home kit (unchanged design from 2025/26). 433FC lists Science Technology as main shirt sponsor and Black Panther as kit maker for 2026/27; the club announced Tameeni as a sponsor in August 2025. The launch and retail shirt images carry no sponsor print, and the back/sleeve breakdown is not confirmed by a text source, so the sponsor list is not complete.
